rows.name: h2_sign_upto
rows.text:
def h2_sign_upto (L₀ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℝ → ℂ, classK k → (∀ u : ℝ, L₀ < |u| → k u = 0) → 0 ≤ poleTerm k - primeSum k + archTerm k

rows.text: theorem h2_sign_imp_upto (L₀ : ℝ) : h2_sign → h2_sign_upto L₀ := fun h k hk _ => h k hk

rows.text: theorem upto_all_imp_h2_sign : (∀ L₀ : ℝ, h2_sign_upto L₀) → h2_sign := by

rows.name: ellOf
rows.text: def ellOf (ρ : ℂ) : ℝ := 1 / (4 * (‖Zeta23.gammaOf ρ‖ + 1))

rows.name: j₀
rows.text: def j₀ (γ δ : ℝ) : ℕ := sorry

rows.name: detection_region
rows.text:
theorem detection_region (L₀ : ℝ) (hL : h2_sign_upto L₀) :
    ∀ ρ : ℂ, riemannZeta ρ = 0 → 0 < ρ.re → ρ.re < 1 →
      (j₀ (Zeta23.gammaOf ρ).re (ρ.re - 1 / 2) : ℝ) * ellOf ρ ≤ L₀ → ρ.re - 1 / 2 = 0 := by

rows.name: literatureRHS
rows.text:
def literatureRHS (k : ℝ → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  paperFT k (I / 2) + paperFT k (-I / 2)
  - ∑' n : ℕ, ((ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / Real.sqrt n : ℝ) : ℂ)
      * (k (Real.log n) + k (-Real.log n))
  + (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * ∫ r : ℝ, paperFT k r * (gammaBracket r : ℂ)

rows.name: EF_lit
rows.text:
def EF_lit (Z : ZeroConfig) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℝ → ℂ, ContDiff ℝ 2 k → HasCompactSupport k →
    Summable (fun ρ : Z.carrier => (Z.mult ρ : ℂ) * paperFT k (gammaOf ρ)) ∧
    ∑' ρ : Z.carrier, (Z.mult ρ : ℂ) * paperFT k (gammaOf ρ) = literatureRHS k

rows.name: EF_lit_zetaZeroConfig
rows.text: theorem EF_lit_zetaZeroConfig : Zeta23.EF.EF_lit zetaZeroConfig := EF_lit_zeta zetaSeam

rows.name: gammaOf
rows.text: def gammaOf (ρ : ℂ) : ℂ := (ρ - 1 / 2) / Complex.I

rows.name: reflect
rows.text: def reflect (ρ : ℂ) : ℂ := 1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) ρ

rows.name: ZeroConfig
rows.text:
structure ZeroConfig where
  /-- the set 𝒵 of distinct zeros -/
  carrier : Set ℂ
  /-- multiplicity m_ρ (value irrelevant off carrier) -/
  mult : ℂ → ℕ
  one_le_mult : ∀ ρ ∈ carrier, 1 ≤ mult ρ
  strip : ∀ ρ ∈ carrier, 0 ≤ ρ.re ∧ ρ.re ≤ 1
  reflect_mem : ∀ ρ ∈ carrier, reflect ρ ∈ carrier
  mult_reflect : ∀ ρ ∈ carrier, mult (reflect ρ) = mult ρ
  /-- local finiteness in the ordinate: finitely many zeros with T₁ < γ ≤ T₂ -/
  finite_window : ∀ T₁ T₂ : ℝ, (carrier ∩ {ρ | T₁ < ρ.im ∧ ρ.im ≤ T₂}).Finite

rows.name: IsNontrivialZero
rows.text: def IsNontrivialZero (ρ : ℂ) : Prop := riemannZeta ρ = 0 ∧ 0 < ρ.re ∧ ρ.re < 1

rows.name: zeroMult
rows.text: def zeroMult (ρ : ℂ) : ℕ := (analyticOrderAt riemannZeta ρ).toNat

rows.name: ZetaSeam
rows.text:
structure ZetaSeam : Prop where
  /-- H-fin: at a nontrivial zero the analytic order is finite and ≥ 1. -/
  one_le_mult : ∀ ρ, IsNontrivialZero ρ → 1 ≤ zeroMult ρ
  /-- H-symm (set): ρ ↦ 1 − conj ρ preserves nontrivial zeros. -/
  reflect_zero : ∀ ρ, IsNontrivialZero ρ → IsNontrivialZero (reflect ρ)
  /-- H-symm (multiplicity). -/
  mult_reflect : ∀ ρ, IsNontrivialZero ρ → zeroMult (reflect ρ) = zeroMult ρ
  /-- local finiteness: finitely many nontrivial zeros with T₁ < γ ≤ T₂. -/
  finite_window : ∀ T₁ T₂ : ℝ, ({ρ | IsNontrivialZero ρ} ∩ {ρ | T₁ < ρ.im ∧ ρ.im ≤ T₂}).Finite

rows.name: zetaZeros
rows.text:
def zetaZeros (hs : ZetaSeam) : ZeroConfig where
  carrier := {ρ | IsNontrivialZero ρ}
  mult := zeroMult
  one_le_mult := hs.one_le_mult
  strip := fun _ h => ⟨h.2.1.le, h.2.2.le⟩
  reflect_mem := hs.reflect_zero
  mult_reflect := hs.mult_reflect
  finite_window := hs.finite_window

rows.name: zetaSeam
rows.text: theorem zetaSeam : ZetaSeam := ZetaSeam.of_reflect zeta_reflect_zero zeta_mult_reflect

rows.name: zetaZeroConfig
rows.text: def zetaZeroConfig : ZeroConfig := zetaZeros zetaSeam

rows.name: riemannZeta_conj
rows.text:
theorem riemannZeta_conj {s : ℂ} (hs : s ≠ 1) :
    riemannZeta (conj s) = conj (riemannZeta s) := by

rows.name: analyticOrderAt_zeta_conj
rows.text:
theorem analyticOrderAt_zeta_conj {w : ℂ} (hw : w ≠ 1) :
    analyticOrderAt riemannZeta (conj w) = analyticOrderAt riemannZeta w := by

rows.name: zeta_reflect_zero
rows.text: theorem zeta_reflect_zero : ∀ ρ, IsNontrivialZero ρ → IsNontrivialZero (reflect ρ) := by

rows.name: zeta_mult_reflect
rows.text: theorem zeta_mult_reflect : ∀ ρ, IsNontrivialZero ρ → zeroMult (reflect ρ) = zeroMult ρ := by

rows.text:
theorem zero_sum_inv_sq_gen (Z : ZeroConfig) {A₀ : ℝ} (hA₀ : 1 ≤ A₀)
    (hloc' : ∀ t : ℝ, (Z.N t (t + 1) : ℝ) ≤ A₀ * Real.log (|t| + 3)) :
    Summable (fun ρ : Z.carrier =>
      (Z.mult ρ : ℝ) / (1 + Complex.normSq (gammaOf ρ))) := by

rows.text:
theorem zero_sum_inv_sq (hs : ZetaSeam) :
    Summable (fun ρ : (zetaZeros hs).carrier =>
      (zeroMult ρ : ℝ) / (1 + Complex.normSq (gammaOf ρ))) := by

rows.text:
theorem EF_zero_sum_summable_gen (Z : ZeroConfig) {A₀ : ℝ} (hA₀ : 1 ≤ A₀)
    (hloc' : ∀ t : ℝ, (Z.N t (t + 1) : ℝ) ≤ A₀ * Real.log (|t| + 3)) {k : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hk : ContDiff ℝ 2 k) (hkc : HasCompactSupport k) :
    Summable (fun ρ : Z.carrier =>
      (Z.mult ρ : ℂ) * paperFT k (gammaOf ρ)) := by

rows.name: weighted_summable
rows.text:
theorem weighted_summable (Z : Zeta23.ZeroConfig) {A₀ : ℝ} (hcount : HCount Z A₀) (f : ℂ → ℝ) (Bf : ℝ)
    (hBf : 0 ≤ Bf) (hf0 : ∀ ρ ∈ Z.carrier, 0 ≤ f ρ)
    (hf : ∀ ρ ∈ Z.carrier, f ρ * (1 + |((⌈ρ.im⌉ : ℤ) : ℝ)|) ^ 4 ≤ Bf) :
    Summable (fun ρ : Z.carrier => (Z.mult ρ : ℝ) * f ρ) := by

rows.name: paperFT_decay
rows.text:
theorem paperFT_decay (p : ℕ) {g : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ p g) (hs : Function.support g ⊆ Set.Icc (-L) L)
    (z : ℂ) : ‖Zeta23.paperFT (phiC g) z‖ * ‖z‖ ^ p ≤ (∫ u, |iteratedDeriv p g u|) * Real.exp (L * |z.im|) := by

rows.name: h2_sign_iff_rh
rows.text: theorem h2_sign_iff_rh : h2_sign ↔ RiemannHypothesis := ⟨h2_sign_imp_rh_holds, rh_imp_h2_sign⟩
